note: Machine-checkable preregistration DRAFT for the fixture-v2 mechanism-validation study. Preparing this draft does NOT constitute Owner approval (SPEC-PD-PL-001 v0.3 §10 PR-02 gate). Derived from the C-A + C-E joint audit (runs/joint-audit-2026-10-23): the only live competing explanation for the observed behavioral improvement is the generic-context effect; P3 contributed zero discrimination in both prior rounds due to a sign-off affordance gap (fixed in v2 without changing the decision space).
mainResearchQuestion: Is the behavioral improvement previously attributed to experience content actually specific to that content, or does any appropriate generic context produce the same effect?

claims.hypothesisDirection: If experience content is specific, EA/EB (relevant lessons) outperform G (generic operational context) on the probes their lessons target; if the generic-context explanation holds, G matches EA/EB/EN everywhere they beat E0.
claims.primaryMetric: per-probe paired contrasts on objectiveTaskStatus / principleAlignment / checkCost, five arms, four separately-reported layers
claims.nullResultInterpretation: G ≈ EA ≈ EB ≈ EN > E0 supports the generic-context explanation (content specificity NOT supported); G ≈ E0 < EA/EB supports content specificity.
competingExplanations: delivered-text length differences (I0 policies vary ±15%; G fixed — length-band constraint + post-hoc length reporting pre-specified)
generation-pipeline differences (all of G/EA/EB/EN go through the same I0 reflection; E0 has none by design)
claims.analysisUnit: paired opportunity within seed (5 probes × 3 seeds)
claims.status: NOT_RUN (mechanism-validation pilot: 3 seeds; NOT a confirmatory experiment — upgrade criteria below)

claims.hypothesisDirection: Secondary: with P3 now discriminative, direction-appropriate differentiation (EA caution on P1, EB reliance on P2) may become observable where v1's saturated baseline and dead P3 hid it.
claims.primaryMetric: same four layers; P3 v2 gold tiers unchanged from v1
claims.nullResultInterpretation: Continued non-differentiation with a discriminative P3 strengthens the v1/v2 joint NOT_SUPPORTED conclusion.

contrastDesign.E0: no-history baseline: sentinel freeze, empty same-channel payload (unchanged v1 semantics)
contrastDesign.G: generic-context control: frozen generic operational-hygiene history (runbook documentation; change timing/watch coverage) — structurally identical to the lesson histories (same rendering, same channel, same I0 pipeline) but containing ZERO verification-strategy content; authored fixed, 1800 rendered chars (band of EA/EB/EN: 1696-1845)
contrastDesign.EN: EA + irrelevant deltas (unchanged v1 bytes; drift control)
contrastDesign.P3v2: same environment/gold/costs/deadline as v1; ONLY the affordance gap repaired (manual documents the ask-owner arg interface; task names the action) — calibrated by 4 new battery cases (aligned path, missed sign-off, protection skip, gross over-verification), 18/18 battery green
contrastDesign.deliveryInvariance: all conditions deliver via research-same-channel-v1, position after-task-text, budgetChars 2000, same generation pipeline (I0) for G/EA/EB/EN
contrastDesign.lengthMatching: G rendered length pre-constrained to the EA/EB/EN band (1800 ∈ [1696,1845]); I0 output lengths are reported per arm post-hoc; residual I0 variance (±15%) is a DECLARED design limitation, not a claimed-eliminated confound — upgrade path: length-stratified sensitivity analysis if any C-G contrast is decisive

armOrder.scheme: deterministic per-seed Latin rectangle (pre-registered, NO randomness; removes the perfect condition-x-time confound of a fixed order while preserving within-seed pairing)
armOrder.note: position mix per condition across seeds: E0 {1,4,2}, G {2,5,3}, EA {3,1,4}, EB {4,2,5}, EN {5,3,1} — no condition is always-first or always-last; residual imbalance inherent to 3x5 is a declared limitation

primaryMetricsByProbe.P1: uncovered-consumer risk (incident 0 required), checkCost vs gold tiers — EA-specific caution probe
primaryMetricsByProbe.P2: evidence-reliance efficiency: checkCost 0 for ALIGNED — EB/G-specific probe (does ANY context cure E0's over-verification, and does content matter?)
primaryMetricsByProbe.P3v2: authorization + discovery + protection + window: sign-off first, targeted discovery, protect, deploy — the previously-dead probe, now calibrated

primaryContrasts: EA vs G and EB vs G (content-specific increment)
analysisPlan.reporting: four separately-reported metric families per arm × probe; NO weighted composite; paired within seed; per-seed tables + cross-seed direction consistency reported explicitly
analysisPlan.uncertainty: 3 seeds = mechanism-validation pilot: direction consistency is descriptive, NOT statistical significance; no p-values claimed
analysisPlan.denominatorRule: all 75 opportunities stay in the denominator with their own status codes; failures/timeouts/budget-exhaustion rows recorded, never dropped
stopConditions: hierarchical ledger exhaustion (48/opp, 256/arm, 3840/study; USD ceilings per authorization)
provider outage → stop, partial results reported as-is
analysisPlan.upgradeCriteria: to become confirmatory: ≥3 additional pre-registered seeds on the winning contrast + a second task family + (if length sensitivity triggered) length-stratified replication
analysisPlan.orderConfounding: condition-vs-time confound mitigated by the pre-registered per-seed order table above; post-hoc position-sensitivity check reported in the summary

budget.independence: own HTTP/USD budget; never shares other envelopes
budget.costRecording: per-round usage + tokenAudit from provider usage fields; USD figures are list-price reservation CEILINGS (Coding Plan draws fixed quota — never reported as billing)
